verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents its own bulk operations: CSV batch upload of manual journal entries, CSV bulk add or edit of the Chart of Accounts, and a 'Batch Categorize Transactions' help article (title only). These are limited to specific item types and are UI/CSV-driven. Nothing shows bulk actions through the API or the MCP agent, which confirms each write change individually. missing for 10: bulk operations via the API or MCP for AI-native workflows, documented detail on batch categorization beyond its title, bulk edit or delete across other item types (invoices, bills, transactions), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Instead of adding them one by one, you can upload a batch of entries all at once using Puzzle's CSV import template.
If you need to bulk add or edit your Chart of Accounts in Puzzle, you can do so by uploading a CSV file directly from your Company Settings.
